name: catalog-001-baseline
statements: CREATE TABLE product_presets(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,code TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT product_presets_code_shape CHECK(length(code)<=50 AND code ~ '^[!-~]([ -~]*[!-~])?$'),kind TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT product_presets_kind_valid CHECK(kind IN('goods','service')),description TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT product_presets_description_not_blank CHECK(length(trim(description))>0),unit_price BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT product_presets_unit_price_nonnegative CHECK(unit_price>=0),unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT product_presets_unit_code_length CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT product_presets_unit_name_length CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),preferred_vat_rate_code TEXT CONSTRAINT product_presets_vat_rate_code_length CHECK(preferred_vat_rate_code IS NULL OR length(preferred_vat_rate_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 32),barcode TEXT CONSTRAINT product_presets_barcode_gtin CHECK(barcode IS NULL OR(barcode ~ '^([0-9]{8}|[0-9]{12,14})$' AND ((ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),1,1))-48)*3+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),2,1))-48)+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),3,1))-48)*3+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),4,1))-48)+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),5,1))-48)*3+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),6,1))-48)+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),7,1))-48)*3+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),8,1))-48)+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),9,1))-48)*3+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),10,1))-48)+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),11,1))-48)*3+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),12,1))-48)+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),13,1))-48)*3+(ascii(substr(lpad(barcode,14,'0'),14,1))-48))%10=0)),UNIQUE(organization_id,id))
CREATE INDEX product_presets_organization ON product_presets(organization_id,(translate(description,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')) COLLATE "C",id COLLATE "C")
